label.administrable_evidence: This opportunity supports state, local, and tribal efforts to enhance their capacity to investigate and prosecute incidents of sexual assault in confinement facilities.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The opportunity aims to enhance the capacity of state and local agencies to investigate and prosecute sexual assaults, which can support the capacity of partners to overcome health disparities.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The opportunity does not directly align with any DMVA strategic plan objectives.
